purpose: General Thingtime share-preview template concepts. Three adaptable design families, each demonstrated with photo post, text post, gallery and page examples.
status: Design concepts only; not connected to production rendering.
content: Illustrative sample copy and generated photographs, not live Thingtime posts.
brandNote: Concepts use canonical branding references. Implementation must use the exact original assets, font files and brand colors.

variants.name: Editorial
variants.prompt:
Create a polished design exploration board for a reusable Thingtime social-link preview template family. This is a general system for ALL shared content, not an invitation card. Board: landscape about 2400x1450, a precise 2 by 2 grid of FOUR separate complete landscape Open Graph cards, each about 1.905:1. Small board title at the top, consistent generous neutral gutters, flat front-facing artwork. No device mockup, perspective, browser chrome, chat app, or decorative background outside the cards. Cards are visibly distinct rectangles; no overlap.
Inputs: image 1 is the actual canonical rainbow voxel Thingtime wordmark on transparency; use this as the exact branding reference, retain proportions, block shapes and color ordering rather than typing a replacement. Image 2 is the canonical lime/brown 4-block tree mark with a square negative space at center. Use sparingly as a visual motif. Do not combine it with a duplicate wordmark in a cluttered header.
Brand: modern, optimistic, personal, playful, beautifully structured. Bold geometric sans similar to Space Grotesk for headings, Hanken Grotesk-like body. Exact palette: mint #59ff9c, sky #59bdff, cyan #00b7ef, blush #ffa3b1, purple #6f3198, lime #a8e61d, yellow #ffc20e, orange #ff7e00, hot pink #ff69b4, ink #17141b, warm white. Strong contrast, title readable at tiny chat-preview size, carefully balanced line breaks, 48-56px safe margins at 1200-card scale. Small wordmark ~200px wide, 56-72px headline, 25-30px optional support at that scale. No tiny paragraph copy. Thumbnail subjects never hidden behind text.
Use these SAME FOUR demonstration content examples, in these exact board positions:
TOP LEFT: PHOTO POST. Exact headline "Small things, big joy." Support "A little sunshine from the garden." Beautiful photoreal image of a small fruiting lemon tree in a terracotta pot on a sunlit pink courtyard floor, natural diagonal afternoon shadows. Give the photograph substantial space.
TOP RIGHT: TEXT POST. Exact headline "The internet feels better with your people." Support "A thought worth sharing." No photograph; let purposeful typography and restrained brand geometry carry the card. This demonstrates the no-image fallback.
BOTTOM LEFT: GALLERY. Exact headline "Little moments lately." Support "4 photos". A cohesive four-photo collage of a lemon close-up, pink flowers, a turquoise ocean, and coffee on a sunny table. Distinct photographic images, not placeholder blocks.
BOTTOM RIGHT: PAGE. Exact headline "The weekend collection." Support "Ideas, places and things to try." Cover photo/still life of a blue notebook, one orange flower, and a yellow cup on a pale tabletop; the page card should feel editorial and useful.
Every card includes the supplied Thingtime wordmark and a discreet "thingtime.com". Every card may have its small uppercase content type, but no extra meta badges, author names, fake buttons, reaction counts, nav bars, phone frames, plus signs, envelopes, emoji or implementation labels. Use no invitation wording anywhere. All typography must be clean and accurate. Make the cards genuinely look like members of one adaptable template system, not unrelated ads.
FAMILY 01 — EDITORIAL. Board title exactly "01 / EDITORIAL". Background outside cards very pale cool gray. Cards are clean warm white with ink typography, subtle 16px corners, no shadows. Strong consistent shared left alignment, 52px interior margins and calm breathing room. Photo post: text left 52%, large edge-to-edge photo right 42%, contained within card silhouette, small mint square at the split only if it helps. Text post: giant ink headline across two-thirds of the card; remaining right side has one cropped stepped purple block and small sky square, very restrained. Gallery: text left 42%, beautifully aligned 2x2 photo grid right 53%, narrow white gutters, matching crops. Page: distinctive panoramic photograph across the upper right half, headline left, generous uncluttered negative space. Keep wordmarks small and consistent near upper left, domain at lower left. The card architecture should feel like a contemporary independent magazine with the bright Thingtime identity. No color gradients, grain, outlines or drop shadows.
